$comment: US-2869 AC5. The shared case list both clients are checked against.
THE TWO CLIENTS DO NOT COVER THE SAME CASES, and pretending otherwise was
the temptation. iOS FriendlyErrorCopy was built for the AUTH surfaces
(US-1025, US-1406, US-1492, US-1521): it knows about weak passwords and
expired magic links and knows nothing about plan limits or an eBay token
that needs reconnecting, because the phone does not publish listings the
way the web does. The web map is the mirror image.
So `platforms` on each case is DATA, not aspiration. The guard asserts
that each client handles what it claims, and prints the asymmetry rather
than hiding it. Adding an iOS case means a Swift enum change, which needs
a compiler this repo's Windows box does not have -- so it is a story, not
`ios` is the FriendlyErrorCopy.Kind name, absent when iOS has no case.
`samples` are raw strings the app has actually produced or would produce.

samples: NetworkError when attempting to fetch resource.
The Internet connection appears to be offline.
Please confirm your email to use this feature.

cases.$why: iOS refreshes its own session and surfaces this as a sign-in prompt rather than an error string.
The web has the plan-gate dialog (US-210). The phone does not gate on plan.
samples: You have hit your monthly limit for AI actions.

cases.$why: eBay OAuth lives on the web. The phone never holds a marketplace token.
An RLS refusal or a workspace-role rejection. Workspaces and sub-accounts are a web feature (US-268); the phone signs in as one person.
samples: That is not allowed for your role.

cases.$why: The web has deep links into rows a user can reach after the row is gone. The phone navigates from lists it just loaded.
Form-shaped writes. iOS validates in the SwiftUI form before submitting, so a 400 from the server is not a case it renders.
samples: Invalid image: the file is not a JPEG

cases.$why: Unique-constraint collisions on names the seller types (sources, saved views, SKUs). Those forms are web-only.
samples: A source with that name already exists
duplicate key value violates unique constraint

cases.$why: The class this story is named for: a database talking to a seller.

iosOnly.$why: A signup rejection. The web handles it in src/lib/auth-error.ts, which predates this map and is not being merged here.
Same: a GoTrue password-policy rejection on the signup form.
samples: Password should be at least 8 characters

iosOnly.$why: A magic-link / PKCE exchange failure. The web's callback page handles it inline.
iOS splits GoTrue's sign-in rejection from the edge's 403 on an authenticated action; the web sees only the second.

pgCodes.$comment: SQLSTATE codes that must NEVER produce 'unknown', because 'unknown' is the one kind that can promote a server string into the headline.
